name: Isodecyl oleate
description: Isodecyl oleate (CAS 67953-27-9 ) is a synthetic ester produced from oleic acid and isodecyl alcohol, used across personal care and industrial sectors as an emollient, lubricant, and plasticizer. Its low viscosity and skin-compatible profile make it a preferred alternative to heavier mineral oil-based ingredients in cosmetic formulations. In personal care, it functions as a lightweight emollient and spreading agent. It is commonly used in skin creams, lotions, sunscreens, and color cosmetics, improving texture and skin feel without greasiness. Lubricant and metalworking formulators incorporate it into cutting fluids and release agents. This material is ideal where biodegradable, bio-based ester chemistry is a sourcing priority. Textile and leather processors use it as a softening and conditioning agent applied during finishing to improve flexibility. It also serves as a plasticizer in specialty coatings and paper treatments where improved substrate flexibility is required. Isodecyl oleate is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid for various uses. Cosmetic-grade material conforming to standard purity specifications is the primary commercial form. Technical-grade material is also available for industrial lubricant and textile applications to meet specific needs. Bulk supply is standard in drums and intermediate bulk containers (IBCs).
